claims.text: Powell is lead author of the 2023 SCU study 'The Reported Shape, Size, Kinematics, Electromagnetic Effects, and Presence of Sound of Unidentified Aerial Phenomena', with Sarah Little, Larry Hancock and others.
Little is a co-author of the 2023 SCU study on reported UAP shape, size, kinematics, electromagnetic effects and sound.
SCU published 'The Reported Shape, Size, Kinematics, Electromagnetic Effects, and Presence of Sound of Unidentified Aerial Phenomena' by Powell, Little, Hancock, Hasan and Truong on 7 December 2023.

edges.label: SCU board member and co-author of the 2023 characteristics study
edges.note: Little is one of the few researchers who publishes with both SCU and the Galileo Project, which is a measure of how small the actual civil analytical bench is.
